instructions:
1. Set the Smith machine bar at about waist height and lock it.
2. Lie on your back under the bar with legs extended and heels on the floor.
3. Grip the bar overhand, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
4. Keep your body straight from head to heels and pull your chest toward the bar.
5. Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
6. Lower with control until arms are straight. Repeat.
tips:
1. Drive the movement by squeezing your shoulder blades together, not just bending your arms.
2. Keep your hips up so your body stays in a straight line.
3. Raise the bar to make it easier or lower it to make it harder.
4. Exhale as you pull up, inhale as you lower.

instructions:
1. Lie on your back with arms out to the sides in a T-shape and legs extended.
2. Lift your right leg toward the ceiling, keeping it straight.
3. Lower the leg across your body toward your left hand, keeping both shoulders flat on the floor.
4. Let the leg drop as far as is comfortable, feeling a stretch in the glutes, hamstrings, and lower back.
5. Hold, then return to the start. Repeat on the other side.
tips:
1. Stretch only as far as is comfortable, never to the point of pain.
2. Keep both shoulders pressed to the floor to target the spine and glutes.
3. Use a mat for comfort.
4. Bend the knee slightly if flexibility is limited.

instructions:
1. Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and feet flat on the floor.
2. Grip both handles with palms facing forward.
3. Press both handles up until your arms are nearly straight.
4. Lower the handles with control back to shoulder level. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your back against the pad throughout.
2. Drive through your shoulders rather than letting your chest take over.
3. Exhale as you press up, inhale as you lower.
4. Move smoothly and avoid swinging the weight.

instructions:
1. Lie flat on your back with legs extended and arms stretched overhead.
2. Lift your upper body and legs at the same time, reaching your hands toward your feet.
3. Form a V-shape with your body at the top.
4. Lower your torso and legs with control back to the floor. Repeat.
tips:
1. Bend your knees slightly if the full movement is too hard.
2. Exhale as you lift, inhale as you lower.
3. Move with control instead of using momentum.
4. Keep your lower back from arching off the floor.

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms at your sides.
2. Lower into a squat by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
3. Explosively jump up, extending your legs fully and swinging your arms for momentum.
4. Land softly with knees bent and hips back, returning to the squat. Repeat.
tips:
1. Land softly on the balls of your feet to absorb impact.
2. Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
3. Move explosively on the way up but control the landing.
4. Keep your chest up and core braced.
